title: General RRCReconfiguration (sent via other RAT) RRCReconfigurationComplete
text: The purpose of this procedure is to, under the control of the network, transfer a connection between the UE and another Radio Access Network (e.g. E-UTRAN) to NR.

The handover to NR procedure applies   when SRBs, possibly in combination with DRBs, are established in another RAT.     Handover from E-UTRA to NR applies   only after integrity has been activated in E-UTRA.
